entries.title: Build browser tools from machine-readable canonical data
entries.summary: Card data, rules, deck legality, and derived tools should share a machine-readable source of truth rather than duplicate text by hand.

entries.title: Use one shared deckbuilder codebase with versioned modes
entries.summary: v0.5 and v0.6 deckbuilders should feel like separate version modes but share maintainable code and permanently version saved decks; do not automatically migrate across the faction boundary.

entries.title: Saved decks use local storage with explicit import/export backup
entries.summary: Browser saves persist locally but can be cleared and do not sync across devices; JSON export/import is the portability and backup mechanism.

entries.title: Provide random decks for testing
entries.summary: The deckbuilder includes a random legal deck generator to accelerate printing and system testing.

entries.title: Automate the battle and state engine before polishing multiplayer
entries.summary: Digital implementation should first enforce zones, card destinations, battle sequence, capture, Assets, Conditions, and win checks; remote multiplayer is layered onto a correct canonical engine.
